Sudara Residences

Кондоминиум — Bang Tao (Cherng Talay)
ГлавнаяПродажаSudara Residences

Developer marketing renders (artist impressions). Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

О проекте

Sudara Residences is a seven-storey, low-density condominium about 500 m from Bang Tao Beach. Phase 1 has 220 residences of one to three bedrooms, about 52 to 110 sqm, with some ground-floor units having private gardens and pools. It is developed by Princess Villa Ltd., a joint venture of Hong Kong's Lan Kwai Fong Group and Phuket's Paradise Group; rental and concierge services are run by the team that manages Andara Resort & Villas in Kamala.

The shared facilities centre on a clubhouse pavilion with a fitness centre and yoga room, pools, co-working space, a kids' club and a residents' rooftop lounge. Parking is underground, with EV charging, and the building uses rooftop solar panels and rainwater recycling. Boat Avenue and the Laguna area are a short drive away.

The project is under construction with completion planned for Q3 2027. Units are offered freehold within the foreign quota, with leasehold also available.

Sudara Residences: ключевые факты

  • Sudara Residences — малоэтажный кондоминиум в Банг Тао, Пхукет, застройщик: Princess Villa Ltd. (Lan Kwai Fong Group and Paradise Group joint venture).
  • Юниты: 1–3 спальни, 52–110 м².
  • Статус строительства: строится; срок завершения: 3 кв. 2027.
  • Форма собственности по данным источников: Фрихолд (Freehold) — право собственности / Лизхолд (Leasehold) — долгосрочная аренда.
  • Заявленная стартовая цена: 13 353 590 ฿.
  • Ближайший пляж: Пляж Банг Тао (500 м).
  • Рядом, по данным проекта: Пляж Банг Тао (500 м).
